description: Chooses, for each conflicting setting in a proposed package update, whether to keep the client's current value or use the package value, and saves the resolved update. Requires the client owner and the update's fingerprint; client facts cannot be overridden this way. It does not apply the update, and the resolved version needs fresh owner approval.

choices.description: For every conflict path listed by preview_update: keep_client or use_package.

expectedRevision.description: The installation revision you last read. The call is rejected if the installation has changed since.

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the proposed update.

installationId.description: The agency package installation to act on.

updateId.description: The proposed update returned by preview_update.

name: agency_installation_resolve_update
title: Resolve Update Conflicts
